Class Distribution

java.lang.Object
common.distributions.Distribution
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServiceStrategy, Cloneable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Batch, Bernoulli, Binomial, Burst, Coxian, Deterministic, DiscreteUniform, Erlang, Exponential, Gamma, Hyperexponential, Lognormal, MAP, MMPP2, Normal, Pareto, PhaseType, Poisson, Poisson, Replayer, ShiftedGeometric, StudentT, Uniform, Weibull, Zipf
public abstract class Distribution extends Object implements ServiceStrategy

Title: Distribution

Description: This abstract class provides a generic pattern used to specify a distribution.

Author:
Bertoli Marco Date: 25-giu-2005 Time: 14.47.12

    • Distribution

      public Distribution(String name, String classpath, String parameterClasspath, String description)
      Constructs a new Distribution object. Initialize all internal objects calling abstract methods setParameterNames(), setParameterClasses(), setParameterValues().
      Parameters:
      name - Name of the distribution
      classpath - engine's classpath for this distribution
      parameterClasspath - engine's classpath for this distribution's parameters
      description - description of this distribution

    • findAll

      public static Distribution[] findAll()
      Returns an array with an instance of every allowed Distribution. Uses internal caching to search for distributions only the first time that this method is called. Note: this method is used to get all continuous distributions. If you need discrete distributions, use findAllDiscrete().
      Returns:
      an array with an instance of every allowed Distribution

    • findAllWithMean

      public static Distribution[] findAllWithMean()
      Returns an array with an instance of every Distribution that allows mean setting. Uses internal caching to search for distributions only the first time that this method is called.
      Returns:
      an array with an instance of every Distribution in which mean value can be specified
